Name: Directional Smooth
Description: Smooths fine terrain variation along the chosen horizontal angle where that direction faces uphill.

Sections.Name: Direction
Sections.Label: Direction
Sections.Description: Angle sets a horizontal direction. The effect follows its positive alignment with the local uphill slope.

Params.Name: Angle
Params.Label: Angle
Params.Description: Sets the horizontal smoothing direction; strength is masked by uphill slope alignment.

Sections.Name: Smoothing
Sections.Label: Fine smoothing
Sections.Description: Applies a Gaussian blur along the angle direction with a terrain-resolution-scaled radius.

Params.Name: Radius
Params.Label: Radius
Params.Description: Radius in pixels at 1K map resolution. It scales with map resolution to keep the terrain-space effect consistent.

Params.Name: Strength
Params.Label: Strength
Params.Description: Blends between the original height and the directionally smoothed result.
